initial_threshold_policy: Tune after the first seven days of server deployment data.

requests.message: API readiness failed. Follow docs/operations.md#api-설정-94s-389.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] queue oldest age
requests.message: Input queue is not draining. Inspect scheduler health and capacity in docs/operations.md#reconcilerscheduler와-worker-격리.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] terminate acceptance latency
requests.message: Terminate acceptance p95 exceeded 200 ms. Correlate the API and control transaction logs by request_id; see docs/operations.md#api-설정-94s-389.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] unknown turn outcome
requests.message: A turn outcome is unknown. Follow docs/operations.md#interrupt-뒤-결과를-알-수-없는-turn.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] interrupt effect latency
requests.message: Interrupt effect p95 exceeded 5 s. Correlate control.result and worker.turn.interrupt.stage by control_id; see docs/operations.md#interrupt-뒤-결과를-알-수-없는-turn.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] checkpoint pending
requests.message: Checkpoint state has remained pending. Follow docs/operations.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션-94s-345.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] checkpoint failure
requests.message: Checkpoint capture or finalize failed. Follow docs/operations.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션-94s-345.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] checkpoint capture late
requests.message: Checkpoint capture exceeded its interrupt budget. Follow docs/operations.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션-94s-345.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] checkpoint capture latency
requests.message: Checkpoint capture p95 exceeded 20 s. Inspect durations_ms on worker.checkpoint.published; see docs/operations.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션-94s-345.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] checkpoint bundle near limit
requests.message: A workspace bundle exceeded 80% of the 256 MiB limit. Inspect the published checkpoint before it is refused.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] checkpoint untracked bytes near limit
requests.message: Untracked workspace bytes exceeded 80% of the 256 MiB limit. Inspect the published checkpoint before capture is refused.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] checkpoint manifest near limit
requests.message: A checkpoint manifest exceeded 80% of the 8 MiB limit. Inspect object counts and transcript growth before publish is refused.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] stale execution lease
requests.message: At least one live attempt is past lease expiry. Inspect reconciler health in docs/operations.md#reconcilerscheduler와-worker-격리.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] worker launch churn
requests.message: Worker resources are repeatedly failing to launch. Follow docs/operations.md#시작-단계에서-계속-죽는-세션-94s-302-94s-347.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] worker exit churn
requests.message: Worker resources are repeatedly exiting. Follow docs/operations.md#시작-단계에서-계속-죽는-세션-94s-302-94s-347.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] scheduler pass failed
requests.message: A scheduler pass failed. Inspect its structured log and status file using docs/operations.md#reconcilerscheduler와-worker-격리.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] provider fallback pricing
requests.message: Provider usage used fallback pricing. Verify the deployed price table before interpreting cost.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] provider hourly cost
requests.message: Provider cost for the last hour exceeded the initial alpha threshold. Check installation and session limits in docs/operations.md#설치-상한-94s-131.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] Docker disk pressure
requests.message: Docker host disk usage exceeded 80%. Follow docs/test-ops.md#감시-지점.

requests.name: [Agent Platform] host inode pressure
